applies_to.observed_behavior: The host adapter appends Expected parameters guidance to an MCP runtime error whenever an advertised input schema exists, conflating runtime/domain failure presentation with request-validation failure presentation.

rationale: The behavior is introduced by the external host adapter after lsp-trace returns its MCP result.
Changing lsp-trace envelopes or advertised schemas to suppress host-added guidance would weaken canonical contracts and create host-specific behavior.
The exception permits lsp-trace release decisions to treat this presentation defect as externally owned while it remains observable and unresolved.

expires_when: the installed pi-mcp-adapter version differs from 2.32.1
the adapter changes direct-tool error rendering
the L04 pass or fail criteria change
lsp-trace changes the affected MCP envelope or advertised input schema
revalidation.required_action: Re-run L04 without assuming this exception and issue an additive superseding exception record if still necessary.
